body.statement: Assume the declared assignment, positivity, randomization, consistency, no-defier, complier-conditional selection-monotonicity, and aggregate target-mass restrictions.  Let the rational local base satisfy \(p_0=p(P_0)\) for some \(P_0\in\mathcal M_{\mathrm{ASC}}\), and impose \(\text{ass:local-tangent-fiber-neighborhood}\).  For sampled-data transfer also impose multinomial interiority, \(p_n(0)\to p_0\), the centered local expansion, and, for a computable moving-offset schedule, \(\text{ass:effective-moving-remainder}\).  Form \(\mathcal F(p_0)\), compute each same-law coordinate endpoint, form the completed active tangent cells, and certify \(u_*\), \(\rho_0\), and \(r_0\).  Conditional on effective compatibility density, CertGluePFL termination, and the compact-exhaustion transfer theorem, CertGluePFL and exact repair yield one simultaneous \(1-\eta_0\) honest semantic-label rule for every assertion in \(\mathscr A_{\mathrm{JC}}\), an \(\varepsilon\)-accurate Gaussian minimax certificate, and a vanishing sampled-data receipt.  On compact local-direction sets away from active faces, tangent labels equal the eventual lawful multinomial labels.  No rectangular joint identified-set claim is made.
body.justification: This is the concrete causal deliverable linking the generic unbounded-fan decision theorem to always-selected-complier multiquantile inference.
body.gap: Blanco, Flores, and Flores-Lagunes report Job Corps average and multiple-quantile wage-effect bounds for the always-employed survivor target under assignment, while Chen and Flores incorporate noncompliance for average effects. Neither provides simultaneous semantic-label honesty for coordinatewise always-selected-complier quantile endpoints under covariate-directional selection or a replayable minimax certificate.
body.consumer: Program evaluators and replication archives obtain a reproducible multiquantile conclusion whose full-law fiber, fixed Gaussian fan, simultaneous label rule, and outward primal-dual ledger can be replayed without selecting favorable quantiles or active faces.

obligation.what_is_open: Produce the simultaneous globally honest semantic-label rule, the terminating Gaussian certificate, and the vanishing global sampled-data receipt.
obligation.obstruction: These outputs consume the unresolved effective incidence modulus, global termination recurrence, corrected fan/radius results, and two-sided expanding-domain transfer.
obligation.attempted: The causal fiber, selected-complier contrasts, same-law endpoint witnesses, compact slack localization, and covariance convergence are all available, but none substitutes for the missing global decision-theoretic constructions.
obligation.partial_result: The observed instrumental-variable contrasts, the finite response-type polytope, and the same-law endpoint witnesses close the causal identification part under the declared assumptions and \(M_{\mathrm{ASC}}\geq m_*>0\).  They yield coordinatewise sharp effect endpoints and the honest outer inclusion for the joint effect vector.  The simultaneous semantic-label rule and sampled-data minimax interpretation still depend on effective incidence density, terminating global certification, and a globally honest unbounded-domain transfer.
